content.text: {"summary":"White has a mating net with the rook on the seventh rank and a rook check on the sixth. Re6+ forces the king to h5, and Rh7 is checkmate. The player used a hint, so the key is seeing that the king can only run to the h-file where the second rook delivers mate.","steps":[{"ply":0,"move":"Re6+","text":"Play Re6+ to check the king on g6 along the sixth rank. This drives the king away from the defence of the seventh rank and leaves it with only one safe square.","annotations":[{"type":"arrow","from":"e1","to":"e6","color":"green"},{"type":"circle","from":"g6","to":null,"color":"red"}],"variation":[]},{"ply":1,"move":"Kh5","text":"The king has to step to h5, since the other squares are covered. Black has no other way to escape the check.","annotations":[{"type":"circle","from":"h5","to":null,"color":"yellow"}],"variation":[]},{"ply":2,"move":"Rh7#","text":"Rook from d7 to h7 gives checkmate on the h-file, with the king on h5 unable to escape. Look for the rook on the seventh rank cutting off the escape squares.","annotations":[{"type":"arrow","from":"d7","to":"h7","color":"green"},{"type":"circle","from":"h5","to":null,"color":"red"}],"variation":[]}],"key_ideas":["check forcing king to a single square","rook mate on the edge"]}
